title: campanula rotundifolia subvar. pinifolia
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subvar. pinifolia, commonly known as Bluebells of Scotland, is a plant species within the bellflower family that is native to the mountainous regions of the Northern Hemisphere. The health benefits of Campanula rotundifolia subvar. pinifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which can aid in reducing anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Campanula rotundifolia subvar. pinifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
